name: TPHR8504PL
description: Toshiba TPHR8504PL 40V N-channel MOSFET (U-MOS-H), package 2-5W1A 'SOP Advance(N)' -- power-stage FET for the 50A tier. Replaces the Infineon IRFB4110PBF (TO-220AB, [20]) so the board can reach the 30 x 70 mm envelope and use double-sided assembly: TO-220 is through-hole and tall, so six of them cost 312 mm^2 and block bottom-side placement. Same part used by the Vimdrones ESC S50 [47], a shipping 6S/50A ESC in 40 x 17 mm.
verification: VERIFIED -- read directly from the local copy of [49] (Toshiba TPHR8504PL datasheet, Rev. 5.0.A, 2026-04-14, 10 pp.), supplied by the repo owner 2026-08-15. Sec. 2 Features: RDS(ON) = 0.7 mOhm typ. at VGS = 10 V; QSW = 23 nC typ.; Qoss = 85.4 nC typ.; Vth = 1.4 to 2.4 V. Sec. 3 'Packaging and Internal Circuit': pins 1/2/3 = Source, pin 4 = Gate, pins 5/6/7/8 = Drain. Sec. 4 Absolute Maximum Ratings (Ta = 25 C): VDSS = 40 V; VGSS = +/-20 V; ID (DC, Tc = 25 C, package limited) = 150 A; ID silicon limit = 340 A; IDP (pulsed, 100 us) = 500 A; PD (Tc = 25 C) = 170 W; EAS = 336 mJ; IAS = 120 A; Tch = 175 C. Sec. 5 Thermal: Rth(ch-c) = 0.88 C/W, Rth(ch-a) = 50 C/W on glass-epoxy board (a). PACKAGE VARIANT: the datasheet offers TWO packages under this part number -- 2-5Q1S 'SOP Advance' (p.8) and 2-5W1A 'SOP Advance(N)' (p.9) -- and states the package 'can be selected according to your preference'. They are pin-compatible but NOT copper-compatible (body 0.75 mm taller, lead frame 0.28 vs 0.166 mm, drain pad 4.21x3.69 vs 4.25x3.50). This design uses 2-5W1A per the repo owner's decision of 2026-08-15; the footprint is for that variant only. NO LAND PATTERN IS PUBLISHED: all 10 pages were searched and the words 'land', 'mounting' and 'recommend' do not appear, so the footprint's fillets are an IPC-7351-style derivation flagged per AGENTS.md Sec.4, not a Toshiba value. COUNTRY OF ORIGIN: Toshiba Electronic Devices & Storage Corporation (Japan) -- satisfies the repo owner's 2026-08-15 constraint that no IC may originate in the PRC or other restricted countries. Related warning: the S50 reference design [47] uses a Fortior FD62880 gate driver, and Fortior Technology is Shenzhen, PRC; it must not be adopted. This build's gate driver remains the TI DRV8353S [21]. OPEN -- VOLTAGE MARGIN IS A DELIBERATE REDUCTION: 40 V against a 6S pack at 25.2 V max (../README.md) is 1.59x, where the superseded IRFB4110PBF gave 3.97x. The repo owner accepted this on 2026-08-15 for the 5.7x conduction-loss improvement (I^2 R at 50 A: 1.75 W here against 10 W for a 4 mOhm part). Hard switching an inductive load rings the drain above the rail, and Vimdrones' own instrumented test [47] logged supply spikes to 27.5 V, so the drain overshoot MUST be bounded before fab -- by the DRV8353S's SPI-programmable IDRIVE slew-rate control, and confirmed by bench measurement of VDS at the switching node. Tracked in TODO.md. NOT YET VERIFIED: AEC-Q101 qualification status, and no thermal calculation has been performed for the 50 A continuous case.
